items.description: Report gives no concrete amounts, timing values, or observed transaction; the reward-capture scenario is only conditional/potential, so no numeric magnitude of captured rewards can be bound.

Report does not specify whether the exchange ratio is manipulable within a single transaction versus only timing-dependent, so the exact temporal relation between stake and reward recording is not fully defined.

Report does not give a numeric definition of the penalty or of the cost of queueWithdrawal, so the 'cost lower than penalty avoided' comparison is represented only as the report-stated qualitative condition.
Report does not specify the exact timing window between queueWithdrawal and the slashing event beyond 'just prior'.
Report gives no numeric definition of 'sufficiently large' staked amounts or of 'significant profits', so the profit magnitude cannot be bound numerically.

Report does not state the quantitative reward amount captured by the front-running stake versus the intended distribution, so the value relation is carried by a grounded Boolean rather than an amount identity.
